Yes, there is a recorded contradiction synthesis titled "Contradiction Between Limitations of Pure Imitation Learning and Successful End-to-End Neural Network Driving" (id: 44d8aea6-14b3-566c-9a9d-70ec8c6cd7d9). 

It captures the disagreement that some papers report limitations of pure imitation learning for driving even with large datasets and advanced representations, while another paper reports successful driving using an end-to-end trained neural network purely through imitation learning.
